## Review

All acceptance criteria are satisfied:

1. `numeric_as_real` consumes `InternalColumn`, moves owned `Real` values, preserves exact `value as f64` conversion, and has a regression guard covering all six owned conversions and clone absence.
2. Protected golden, fixture, CLI, IR, CUDA, Cargo, and differential-evidence paths are unchanged. All eleven measured/profiled primary CSVs, summaries, manifests, and final-state hashes match exactly.
3. Focused test, `cargo test --locked` (52 successful groups), and `scripts/check-rust.sh` pass. Evaluation order, integer fast paths, diagnostics, and IEEE-754 operations remain unchanged.
4. Evidence records five runs per side, every contention calculation, fastest uncontended user-time headlines, and medians. The permitted result is a negligible 0.51% user-time regression.
5. The full-duration profile is present, hash-verified, and contains 6,088 main-execution samples including the targeted evaluator paths.
6. Markdown link validation and `git diff --check` pass.

```json
{"assessment":"APPROVED","blockingIssues":[],"summary":"PRD 0004 is fully satisfied: owned Real buffers move without copying under regression coverage, semantics and protected artifacts remain unchanged, the complete in-run five-by-five contention-aware corpus and full-duration profile are present and internally verified, the permitted negligible negative result is reported honestly, and all required gates pass."}
```
